goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: Include content up to which chapter?
This provides a means to shorten (or lengthen) a playthrough by including only items and locations up to the specified chapter (and its following intermission)
0 for Prologue, 1-7 for the main story and 8-9 for the dlc.
Include items and locations that require the DLC?
When true this allows any items or locations related to DLC content to be added into the pool, so long as they're still accessible by the chapter limit chosen.
For example, this could allow for 5 bigger bag bonuses rather than 4 even if the chapter limit is set to 7.
Include password rewards?
When true you can only claim passwords you've received. Also includes locations for claiming each and every password.
Include bliss into the pool?
When true, bliss bonuses will be turned into items and there will be locations for claiming them.
Not all bonuses may be included if the chapter limit is low enough.
Include the audio and video bliss bonuses into the pool?
Does nothing if bliss isn't enabled, adds two items and locations.
Include the audio and video bliss bonuses into the pool?
Does nothing if bliss isn't enabled, adds three items and locations.
Include Life licenses and their related tasks into the pool?
When true you can only use Lives for which you have licenses unlocked, up to the rank matching the amount of licenses received.
The respective ranks unlocked are:
1 - Fledgling and Novice
2 - Apprentice
3 - Adept
4 - Expert
5 - Master
6 - Hero
7 - Legend
8 - Demi-Creator and Creator
Include Area licenses and the ability to interact with anything within an area?
This means gathering, shopping, fighting and taking on other requests can only be allowed in an area once you have the license for it.
Butterfly requests may be an exception since those are required to advance the story.
Include Shop licenses and the ability to buy/sell at specific shops?
When combined with area licenses you can only shop at a location if you have both the respective shop and its area's licenses.
Include shop items into the pool?
When true, every purchasable item in a shop will become a check. May require farming for a lot of dosh.
Auto-hint shop locations?
Does nothing if shopsanity isn't enabled. Can save you some trouble instead of needing to buy everything.
Include shop items that require being at a certain level?
Does nothing if shopsanity isn't enabled.
Include shop items that require unlocking with Bliss?
Does nothing if shopsanity isn't enabled.
Include shop items that require reaching Master rank at specific lives?
Does nothing if shopsanity isn't enabled, or if it's not possible to reach Master rank at the chosen chapter limit.
Include shop items that require having beaten the main story?
Does nothing if shopsanity isn't enabled, or if it's not possible to beat the main story at the chosen chapter limit.
Include shop items that require having beaten the dlc?
Does nothing if shopsanity isn't enabled, or if it's not possible to beat the dlc at the chosen chapter limit.
Include shop items that require Lunares Coins?
Does nothing if shopsanity isn't enabled, or if the chapter limit isn't set to 9.
Not recommended because of how late content this is and how much of a grind it could be to acquire all of those coins.
This is a Toggle
A simple boolean, aka True or False set the initial value with "default"
This is a Choice
Let the user pick from a list of values
allow_custom_value let a player define their own text value
Currently the only use for Choice in Manual outside of hooks is the goal
This is a Range
Allow the player to specify a value between 'start' and 'end'
if you include a "values" you can define the label for certain values
Currently the only use for Range in Manual outside of hooks is 'filler_trap'
